name: Casa Alcores
description:
Casa Alcores is a bright and elegant apartment located within the exclusive Alcores del Golf community, in the heart of Nueva Andalucía’s prestigious Golf Valley. Surrounded by renowned golf courses, beautifully maintained gardens and peaceful residential surroundings, it offers the perfect setting for a relaxing stay on the Costa del Sol.

The property comfortably accommodates up to 6 guests and features 3 bedrooms and 2 bathrooms. Large windows throughout the apartment allow plenty of natural light to enter, while the spacious layout creates a comfortable environment for both short and extended stays.

One of the property's standout features is its generous outdoor living space. The private terrace has been designed as an extension of the interior and includes an outdoor dining area, an outdoor kitchen and a Big Green Egg barbecue, creating the perfect setting for long lunches, relaxed dinners and entertaining with family and friends throughout the year.

Surrounded by mature greenery and overlooking the beautifully maintained gardens and golf course, the terrace offers a peaceful and private environment where guests can fully enjoy Marbella’s exceptional climate. Whether enjoying a morning coffee, dining outdoors or simply unwinding in the fresh air, this outdoor space can be enjoyed throughout the seasons.

Inside, the apartment combines comfort and functionality with inviting living spaces, well-appointed bedrooms and a bright, airy atmosphere throughout. The open-plan living area connects seamlessly with the terrace, creating a natural flow between indoor and outdoor living.

Guests also have access to a communal swimming pool and landscaped gardens within the urbanisation, providing the perfect place to relax after a day at the beach, exploring Marbella or enjoying a round of golf.

Ideally located just minutes from Puerto Banús, Marbella’s beaches, restaurants, golf courses, shops and leisure facilities, Alcores Retreat combines comfort, tranquillity and an excellent location, making it an ideal choice for families, couples and golf enthusiasts alike.

* Explore the Surroundings

Beyond the tranquillity of Alcores del Golf, the property is perfectly positioned for discovering some of Southern Spain’s most sought-after destinations.

• Enjoy the beaches, marina and vibrant atmosphere of Puerto Banús

• Explore Marbella’s charming Old Town, boutiques and restaurants

• Play on some of the Costa del Sol’s most prestigious golf courses

• Discover the picturesque village of Benahavís and its renowned gastronomy

• Experience Málaga’s culture, museums and culinary scene

• Visit the breathtaking landscapes and history of Ronda

• Explore Gibraltar and its famous Rock overlooking Africa

• Enjoy memorable day trips across Andalucía

Please note that we welcome families and couples only, no groups under 30, and no hen or stag parties. Should you fall outside of this category but wish to book nonetheless, please send us an enquiry detailing a bit more about yourself and the group that you will be travelling with so we can request this for you.

Don’t forget to ask about our concierge service! We look forward to welcoming you.
